title: The skull-mouthed dungeon gate
place: A storm-lit cliff with a dungeon entrance carved as a giant skull, a warning sign nailed to a dead tree, a crow on every branch
situation: A freshly formed adventuring party argues about marching order at the gate while lightning flashes and the skull's jaw creaks open
cast: wizard reading the map upside down
jokeHooks: the party argues about marching order like a PR debate over naming
the warning sign is a deprecation notice everyone ignores
the wizard packed ten spells and none of them is the one needed

title: Graveyard above the crypt
place: A foggy hilltop graveyard under a full moon, tilted tombstones, a crumbling mausoleum with stairs leading down, bony hands poking up
situation: Adventurers tiptoe between graves while skeletons pop up one at a time, each politely asking for a password
visualTropes: a full moon behind a mausoleum
jokeHooks: each skeleton requires a separate password like a stack of auth layers
the graves are old abandoned feature branches
killing one skeleton just respawns it like a restarting crash loop

title: Vine-choked jungle ziggurat
place: A stepped stone pyramid swallowed by jungle, giant stone heads, vines thick as arms, a waterfall roaring beside the stairs
situation: The party climbs the endless stairs to the summit door while monkeys steal their gear and the stone heads watch
cast: sweaty explorer with a whip and hat
visualTropes: tiny figures on a huge pyramid
jokeHooks: the stairs are like a build log that never ends
monkeys steal one item at a time like a memory leak
the porter is the only one with the right credentials

title: Tomb door in the sandstorm
place: A half-buried pyramid in rolling dunes, a sandstorm wall approaching, jackal-headed statues guarding a sealed door of hieroglyphs
situation: The party races to decode the door's glyph puzzle before the sandstorm buries them, while the statues slowly turn their heads
jokeHooks: the glyph puzzle is a regex nobody can read
the camel refuses to move until its dependencies are satisfied
the mummy shows up early like a premature deploy

title: Rolling boulder escape
place: A long sloping stone corridor, spikes shooting from walls, a giant round boulder thundering down behind the party
situation: Someone lifted the golden idol off its pedestal and now everyone sprints, dodging darts and leaping a pit, with the boulder gaining
visualTropes: explorer diving through a closing gap
a hat snatched back at the last second
jokeHooks: swapping the idol for a bag of sand is like a hotfix with the wrong weight
one tiny change starts a cascade nobody can stop
the boulder is the deadline everyone ignored

title: The treasure chest has teeth
place: A dusty treasure room with gold piles and an ornate chest in the center, torches flickering, a skeleton slumped next to it
situation: The greedy thief opens the chest and it chomps down; the party tries to pry it off while other chests around them sprout tongues
cast: greedy thief with an arm in a chest
fighter hitting it with a shield
visualTropes: a chest with fangs and a long tongue
a thief yanked off their feet
jokeHooks: the chest looked like a free upgrade but bites like a breaking change
every chest is a dependency that might be a mimic
the manual says to check for teeth but nobody reads the docs

title: The wobbling jelly cube
place: A perfectly square torchlit corridor, a giant transparent wobbling jelly cube sliding toward the party, swallowed junk floating inside
situation: The party retreats down a dead end as the cube sucks in everything in its path: swords, boots, a very surprised goblin
visualTropes: a corridor filled wall to wall
a dead-end wall behind the party
jokeHooks: the cube absorbs everything like a monorepo
inside are old artifacts nobody has cleaned up in years
the cube moves exactly one tile per turn like a slow CI runner

title: Boss fight in the lich's throne room
place: A cavernous throne room over a lava pit, crumbling pillars, floating crystals, a robed skeletal sorcerer with a glowing phylactery
situation: The final boss reveals a second phase, then a third, while the party is out of potions and the floor keeps collapsing into lava
visualTropes: a glowing jar on a pedestal
jokeHooks: every time the boss is beaten a new phase begins, like another review round
the boss keeps reviving until someone finds the hidden config file
the bard writes release notes for a fight not yet won

title: Tavern of the quest board
place: A rowdy adventurers' tavern with a giant cork quest board, barbarians arm wrestling, a dwarf asleep in the soup, a mysterious hooded patron
situation: Adventurers jostle at the quest board; every quest is to kill rats in a cellar for a suspiciously small fee
cast: shady quest giver in a hood
visualTropes: a board overflowing with paper quests
a hooded figure with a sack of coins
jokeHooks: the quest board is a backlog of tickets all labeled good first issue
every quest giver wants it done by yesterday for exposure
the rat cellar quest has been reopened forty times

title: Underground goblin bazaar
place: A cavern market lit by mushroom lanterns, rickety stalls, goblins hawking cursed rings, potion carts and suspicious used armor
situation: The party haggles for a key while goblin vendors swarm, each claiming their key is the real one
jokeHooks: every key is a slightly different fork of the right one
potions labeled works on my cauldron
the troll charges a toll per request

title: Pit arena of the underdark
place: A circular pit arena carved from rock, roaring crowds of orcs and goblins on stone tiers, a gate opening to reveal a monster
situation: The captured party is thrown into the pit to fight a bull-headed brute while the crowd places bets
cast: ring announcer with a megaphone horn
visualTropes: sand and bones in the pit
jokeHooks: the crowd bets on which test will fail first
the brute is the legacy module nobody wants to touch
the announcer reads out the changelog before the fight

title: Hall of pressure plates
place: A long torchlit hall with a checkered floor of pressure plates, holes in the walls for darts, a swinging blade at the far end
situation: The thief inches across, testing each tile with a ten-foot pole, while the fighter behind them just walks across and triggers everything
cast: cautious thief with a ten-foot pole
visualTropes: a checkered floor of suspicious tiles
jokeHooks: testing each tile with a pole is like writing tests first
the fighter merges straight to main and triggers every trap
the previous adventurer's skeleton is the last person who tried a shortcut

title: Puzzle room with rising water
place: A sealed stone chamber with six levers, a riddle carved above a locked door, water pouring in from gargoyle mouths
situation: The party tries lever combinations as water rises to their necks; the wizard insists on reading the riddle aloud slowly
visualTropes: water rising in a sealed room
jokeHooks: pulling levers at random is like bisecting commits by guesswork
the riddle is ambiguous like a vague ticket
the gargoyle offers hints only after a timeout

title: Safe room with a crackling fire
place: A small torchlit stone room with a crackling fire, a glowing save crystal, battered gear drying on racks
situation: The bruised party rests before the boss door, counting supplies and arguing about whether to save their progress
jokeHooks: the save crystal is a commit right before a risky refactor
nobody remembers the last checkpoint, like an untagged release
the party splits the loot like a team splitting tickets
